description: This file defines the JournalEntry class used in integration tests related to accounting within the Fineract project. It includes an inner enum for transaction types and methods to access transaction details.
external_files: other project dependencies possibly referenced indirectly

classes.name: JournalEntry
classes.description: Represents a financial journal entry for testing purposes, encapsulating transaction amount, type, and optional office ID.

classes.name: TransactionType
classes.description: Enumerates possible transaction types: CREDIT and DEBIT.

methods.name: JournalEntry
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a journal entry with amount and type.

methods.name: getTransactionAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionType
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the transaction type.
